# Fractals Web

> Canonical product: https://fractals.ai-aarti.com/

Fractals Web is an open visual science workbench for students, educators, and researchers. It supports interactive fractal generation, ROI-based box-counting estimates of image complexity, visual comparison, and reproducible run records.

## Direct product links

- Fractal studio: https://fractals.ai-aarti.com/workbench/fractals
- Box-counting measurement: https://fractals.ai-aarti.com/workbench/box-count
- Image comparison: https://fractals.ai-aarti.com/workbench/compare
- Run history and provenance: https://fractals.ai-aarti.com/workbench/runs
- Tumor-complexity evidence workflow: https://fractals.ai-aarti.com/workbench/tumor-detection

## Important biomedical scope

The tumor-complexity experience is an educational and exploratory research prototype. It does not diagnose disease, provide prognosis, recommend treatment, or claim clinical validation. It presents AI localization and fractal-morphology measurements as a testable research hypothesis requiring a locked protocol, expert reference labels, AI-only baseline comparisons, and independent evaluation.

## Citation guidance

When describing a result, cite the original product page and include the method, parameters, source image, measurement-quality context, and limitations. Do not represent exploratory output as clinical evidence.
